C-EDIT-FORMAT-ROUTING.IntentSummary: Implement per-model edit-format routing in the hashline-edit plugin: session-model detection via chat.message, per-model tool visibility via UserMessage.tools mutation, native replace profile (qwen/kimi), native dsh str_replace_editor profile (deepseek), hashline rename to hashline_edit with three-part-ref enforcement and replace/replace_range unification, routing config union in vvoc schema, and editMode telemetry metadata.

T-001.Title: Routing core and session state: EditMode resolver, routing config parsing, session model cache, session file cache

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: routing.ts exports EditMode (hashline | replace | str_replace_editor | passthrough), parseRoutingConfig (strict, invalid values throw), and resolveEditMode(config, providerID, modelID) matching case-insensitive substring rules against providerID then modelID, first match wins, default hashline.
session-state.ts exports a session model cache (set/get by sessionID) and a session file cache (record/check mtime+size per sessionID+path) with drift detection.
Tests cover rule precedence, provider-then-model matching, unknown-model default, cache hit/miss, and file drift detection.

T-002.Title: vvoc config schema union: plugins.hashline-edit accepts boolean or object with enabled and routing

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: schemas/vvoc/v3.json plugins values accept boolean or an object with optional enabled boolean and optional routing object (default string enum plus rules record of enum modes); existing boolean configs validate unchanged.
vvoc-config parsing exposes the resolved hashline-edit plugin settings; invalid routing values fail loudly at load.
plugin-toggle-config isVvocPluginEnabled treats the object form via its enabled field, defaulting true when absent.

T-003.Title: Replace engine: qwen/kimi native replace contract with prior-read enforcement and visible fallbacks

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Exact literal match applies; zero matches return a teaching error directing to re-read; multiple matches without replace_all return an error naming the occurrence count; replace_all replaces every occurrence; old===new and empty-old-on-existing-file are rejected.
Fallback layers are limited to unicode confusables and trailing whitespace (indentation never relaxed) and each used layer emits a visible warning in the output.
Prior-read enforcement uses the session file cache: unread file rejected in default strict mode, mtime/size drift since read rejected fail-closed; mode configurable strict | warn | off.
Successful results include the bounded diff summary (+A/-R, first change line) and editMode metadata.

T-004.Title: DeepSeek profile: dsh str_replace_editor contract (view/create/str_replace/insert) with view-cache CAS equivalent

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: view renders the dsh header, 6-padded line numbers with two spaces, view_range validation with dsh error texts, and the dsh truncation marker at maxOutputChars; directory view lists two levels excluding hidden, node_modules, __pycache__.

str_replace matches exact-verbatim only; zero matches return the dsh FS_EDIT_NOT_FOUND text; multiple matches return the ambiguity text listing all occurrence line numbers; insert validates insert_line range and inserts after the line; create rejects existing files with the dsh guard text; relative paths return the absolute-path hint.
Mutations check the view-cache mtime/size snapshot and reject fail-closed when the file drifted since the last view.

T-005.Title: Hashline hardening: mandatory three-part refs, replace/replace_range unification, neighbor-duplicate warnings

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Edit operations reject two-part LINE#HASH refs with a teaching error that shows the required three-part form; read output and mismatch snippets keep rendering full triples.

replace accepts an optional end anchor and applies as a range when present; replace_range remains accepted as an alias; multi-line replace without end is rejected with add-end guidance; the obsolete replace-does-not-accept-end error is gone.
Payload lines that duplicate surviving neighbors outside the exact-echo cases produce visible warnings while still applying literally.
tool-description documents mandatory three-part anchors and the unified replace semantics with updated examples.

T-006.Title: Plugin wiring: register hashline_edit, replace edit, and str_replace_editor; chat.message model cache and UserMessage.tools visibility mutation; routed read hook; tool.execute.before safety net; editMode telemetry

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Plugin registers hashline_edit (renamed hashline semantics), edit (replace profile with snake_case and camelCase parameter aliases), and str_replace_editor; routing config is read from the startup vvoc snapshot with the default table (qwen replace, kimi replace, deepseek str_replace_editor, gpt/codex passthrough, default hashline).

chat.message populates the session model cache from UserMessage.model and mutates UserMessage.tools to hide every edit-type tool outside the resolved profile; tests assert on real SDK UserMessage shapes.
tool.execute.before rejects wrong-profile tool calls with a teaching error naming the correct tool; read hook applies anchor transform only for hashline sessions.
Every edit-type result metadata includes editMode, providerID, modelID; boolean false plugin toggle still disables everything; boolean true uses default routing.

T-007.Title: Durable state and docs: graph and verification updates, README routing section

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: M-PLUGIN-HASHLINE-EDIT graph entry reflects routing, the three registered tools, and the rename; M-PLUGIN-TOGGLE-CONFIG and M-CLI-CONFIG entries reflect the config union where touched.
V-M-PLUGIN-HASHLINE-EDIT verification entry records the new targeted test files and the telemetry rerun procedure.
README documents the routing table, config shape, per-model tool visibility, and the hashline rename.
